shellCommands.command: echo "=== middleware.md ===" && cat 01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/middleware.md && echo "=== getting-started/16-proxy.md ===" && cat 01-app/01-getting-started/16-proxy.md
find app __agent_eval__ -type f | head -40 && echo "---TSCONFIG---" && cat tsconfig.json && echo "---NEXTCONFIG---" && cat next.config.ts

(npx next dev --port 3111 > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 45); do sleep 2; if grep -qE "Ready|started server" /tmp/next-dev.log 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; done; tail -5 /tmp/next-dev.log

for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3111/ 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 2; done; echo "=== HEADERS / ===" && curl -s -D - -o /dev/null http://localhost:3111/ | grep -iE "^HTTP|x-request-id" && echo "=== HEADERS /some/page (2nd req) ===" && curl -s -D - -o /dev/null http://localhost:3111/some/page | grep -iE "^HTTP|x-request-id"

grep -a "\[proxy\]" /tmp/next-dev.log | head -20; echo "--- static asset check (should be no header) ---"; ASSET=$(curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -oE '/_next/static/[^"]+\.js' | head -1); echo "asset: $ASSET"; curl -s -D - -o /dev/null "http://localhost:3111$ASSET" | grep -iE "^HTTP|x-request-id"
pkill -f "next dev" ; pkill -f "next-server" ; sleep 1; echo stopped
